# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| 0.x (latest) | ✅ |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Do not open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.**

Email **security@usegately.com** with:
- Description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce
- Potential impact
- Any suggested fix (optional)

We will acknowledge within **48 hours** and aim to patch within **7 days** for critical issues. You will be credited in the release notes unless you prefer to remain anonymous.
